name: skills
description: A monorepo of independently installable Claude Code skills, each packaged as its own plugin.

plugins.name: commit-and-push
plugins.description: Safely commit a completed logical chunk of work and push it to the remote branch.

plugins.name: durable-worktree-safety
plugins.description: Keep active Git work durable and pull request branches clean.

plugins.name: estimate-time-and-tokens
plugins.description: Forecast time, tokens, files, and diff size, then calibrate future estimates against completed work.

plugins.name: hitl-pr-review-walkthrough
plugins.description: Create a reviewer walkthrough for human-in-the-loop pull request testing and merge decisions.

plugins.name: impeccable-to-issues
plugins.description: Draft vertical-slice issue Markdown inside the repository before publishing it.

plugins.name: impeccable-to-prd
plugins.description: Draft PRD Markdown inside the repository before publishing it.

plugins.name: mvp-scope-guard
plugins.description: Keep proposed work limited to the smallest verifiable MVP.

plugins.name: pipe-down
plugins.description: Run exactly one shell command per Bash call so commands match Claude Code's permission allowlist and run without re-prompting.

plugins.name: timebox-routine-ops
plugins.description: Finish routine local operations quickly without process sprawl.
